metadata.name: pepper_dividends
metadata.description: Pepper (pepper.fan) USDC dividends: a token's month paid in USDC against a merkle root, each holder claiming into their own USDC account

docs: The instructions, each with its LiteSVM suite (the canonical doc, §3).

instructions.name: claim
docs: Leaf `index` paid into the claimant's own USDC account, from any sender.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The month. Only this program creates one, at its own address: its owner and discriminator
bind it, and its seeds sign for the vault.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The month's vault: the distributor's associated USDC account.

accounts.name: claimant_usdc
docs: The claimant's own USDC ATA, which a holder without one creates in the same transaction.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The config's USDC (`AccountMismatch` for another mint).

instructions.name: close_distributor
docs: A month closed by its funder or the closer: what is left back to the funder, the rents to
the rent payer, the record kept closed.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The month's funder or the config's closer (`Unauthorized` for any other key).

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The month. Only this program creates one, at its own address: its owner and discriminator
bind it, and it names the accounts the money and the rents go back to (`AccountMismatch`
for any other), as the funding or a re-home (`rehome_distributor`) last wrote them.

accounts.name: month_record
docs: The month's record, bound by its seeds (`ConstraintSeeds` for another month's), kept closed.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The month's vault: the distributor's associated USDC account.

accounts.name: funder_usdc_account
docs: it, so an empty vault closes even while its owner has closed it; a vault holding USDC needs
it open again first, `create_idempotent` in the same transaction.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: distributor's rents go back to it.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The config's USDC (`AccountMismatch` for another mint).

instructions.name: hold_claims
docs: One month's claims held until `until`, by the pauser or the admin: only started or
extended, an hour at least and 7 days at most; every other month keeps claiming.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The pauser or the admin; each instruction checks which may act.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The month. Only this program creates one, at its own address: its owner and discriminator
bind it.

instructions.name: init_distributor
docs: A month funded: the funder's µUSDC into the vault, with the approver's signature, the
dividend payer paying the rents; its claims held for its review window, a day.

accounts.name: funder
docs: Its USDC pays: the config's `pepper_funder` or `payer_funder`, or the curve's creator.

accounts.name: approver
docs: The config's approver, a key of its own, co-signing every month (`Unauthorized` for another).

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Pays the three rents, the record's, the distributor's and the vault's: the config's
dividend payer (`Unauthorized` for any other key, the internal audit of 2026-10-29), a
creator's month included, so a creator spends only USDC and every month's rents go back
to a key `rehome_distributor` can move.

accounts.name: curve
docs: and read by hand (`curve_creator`) only when the funder is neither Fanex key: a Fanex month
opens for a mint with no curve.

accounts.name: legacy_distributor
docs: and v2 distributors of this token and month share (`ConstraintSeeds` for another month's or
mint's), read by hand (`legacy_month_live`): a v1 or v2 month there blocks this one until
its expiry, any other data for good, whatever its owner (`LegacyMonthLive`).

accounts.name: month_record
docs: Created with the month and never closed. Before the distributor, with a check of its own:
Anchor runs the init fields in their order, so a month open or closed is `MonthAlreadyFunded`
before the distributor's `init` would meet an account in use. A voided one opens again. One
this funding creates reads version 0; any version but that and `ACCOUNT_VERSION` is
`UnsupportedVersion`.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The distributor's associated USDC account. `init_if_needed`: anyone may create it first,
which `init` would refuse for good; Anchor checks what it finds (its mint, its owner, its
token program, its address), and the close sweeps whatever a stranger left in it.

accounts.name: funder_usdc
docs: The funder's own USDC ATA (`AccountMismatch` for any other account), recorded so the close
can always reach it: anyone can open an ATA again, so a funder who closed theirs cannot keep
a month from closing.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The config's USDC (`AccountMismatch` for another mint).

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Signed by this program's upgrade authority, read from its ProgramData.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the config's rent: on mainnet the vault itself, since a vault transaction carries no
other keypair's signature.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: This program's upgrade authority, as its ProgramData records it.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: `program_data_upgrade_authority`. The program's ProgramData, the upgradeable loader's PDA
of the program id (`ConstraintSeeds` anywhere else, so another program's ProgramData is
refused), owned by the loader, whose recorded authority must be the signer:
`Unauthorized` for any other key, for an immutable program, which records none, and for a
program loaded without the upgradeable loader, which has no ProgramData.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin: an account the system program owns, as a Squads vault is (`AccountNotSystemOwned`
otherwise). The multisig account is the Squads program's and never signs: an admin handed to
it would be lost for ever (MULTISIG.md §2).

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The classic SPL Token USDC of 6 decimals (`AccountOwnedByWrongProgram` for Token-2022's,
`ConstraintMintDecimals` for another number of decimals). Set once.

accounts.name: curve_program
docs: (`ConstraintExecutable`, `ConstraintOwner`): set once, a wrong key would turn
`LegacyMonthLive` off for good and every creator month into `CurveUnreadable`. Which program
it is the caller's to check (B13's script requires `pepper_curve`'s id).

instructions.name: pause_claims
docs: Claims paused until `until`, by the pauser or the admin: only started or extended, an hour
at least and 7 days at most from when it runs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The pauser or the admin; each instruction checks which may act.

instructions.name: rehome_distributor
docs: An open month's funder, its USDC account and its rent payer moved by the admin to the
config's dividend payer as it stands, each only where the funding recorded a Fanex payee.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin, the upgrade Squad's vault (`Unauthorized` for any other key, the month's funder
and the closer included).

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The month. Only this program creates one, at its own address: its owner and discriminator
bind it; a month closed or voided is gone (`AccountNotInitialized`).

instructions.name: release_claims
docs: That month's claims open again, by the admin alone, at the time it runs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The pauser or the admin; each instruction checks which may act.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The month. Only this program creates one, at its own address: its owner and discriminator
bind it.

instructions.name: resume_claims
docs: Claims open again, by the admin alone, at the time it runs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The pauser or the admin; each instruction checks which may act.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: The funding paused by the pauser or the admin, unpaused by the admin alone.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The pauser or the admin; each instruction checks which may act.

instructions.name: top_up_distributor
docs: More µUSDC into an open month from its funder's USDC, with the approver's signature: its
total grows by as much, its root stays.

accounts.name: funder
docs: The month's funder as the month records it (`Unauthorized` for any other key): its USDC pays.

accounts.name: approver
docs: The config's approver, co-signing as at the funding (`Unauthorized` for another key).

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The month. Only this program creates one, at its own address: its owner and discriminator
bind it; a month closed or voided is gone (`AccountNotInitialized`).

accounts.name: vault
docs: The month's vault: the distributor's associated USDC account.

accounts.name: funder_usdc_account
docs: associated account: the transfer reads it, signed by the funder.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The config's USDC (`AccountMismatch` for another mint).

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Signed by the admin; each key an `Option`, the admin through `new_admin`.

accounts.name: new_admin
docs: The next admin, held to `initialize_config`'s owner rule (`AccountNotSystemOwned`); `None`
keeps the admin.

instructions.name: void_distributor
docs: A month funded wrong, voided by the admin while nobody has claimed from it: settled as at a
close, the record voided, so the month may be funded again.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin, the upgrade Squad's vault (`Unauthorized` for any other key).

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The month, naming the accounts the money and the rents go back to, as at a close
(`AccountMismatch` for any other).

accounts.name: month_record
docs: The month's record, bound by its seeds (`ConstraintSeeds` for another month's), kept voided.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The month's vault: the distributor's associated USDC account.

accounts.name: funder_usdc_account
docs: alone, as at a close.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The config's USDC (`AccountMismatch` for another mint).

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Funding is paused

errors.name: ClaimsPaused
errors.msg: Claims are paused

errors.name: PauseTooLong
errors.msg: A claims pause may end at most 7 days from now

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: AccountMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not match the expected one

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Numeric overflow

errors.name: InvalidLeafCount
errors.msg: A month needs between 1 and 65,536 leaves

errors.name: InvalidLeafIndex
errors.msg: Leaf index is outside this month's claim registry

errors.name: InvalidProof
errors.msg: Merkle proof verification failed

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: This dividend has already been claimed

errors.name: ExceedsFundedTotal
errors.msg: Claim would exceed the month's funded total

errors.name: ExpiryTooFar
errors.msg: A month may expire at most 400 days from its funding

errors.name: NotExpired
errors.msg: The month is neither expired nor fully claimed

errors.name: NotAFunder
errors.msg: Only Fanex's two funders or the curve's creator may fund a month

errors.name: LegacyMonthLive
errors.msg: pepper_curve still holds a live distributor for this token and month

errors.name: CurveUnreadable
errors.msg: The curve is neither a Curve nor a CurveUsdc of pepper_curve

errors.name: ExpiryTooSoon
errors.msg: A month must expire at least 364 days from its funding

errors.name: ClaimsPausedRecently
errors.msg: Claims were paused too recently for an expired month to close

errors.name: MonthAlreadyFunded
errors.msg: This month was already funded here: it is open or closed

errors.name: MonthHasClaims
errors.msg: A month with a claim cannot be voided

errors.name: PauseEndTooEarly
errors.msg: A claims pause may only start or extend, never end before now or the current end

errors.name: ApproverIsFunder
errors.msg: The approver must be a key of its own, neither Fanex funder

errors.name: ClaimsHeld
errors.msg: This month's claims are held

errors.name: PauseTooShort
errors.msg: A claims pause or hold must end at least an hour from now

errors.name: UnsupportedVersion
errors.msg: The account's layout version is not one this program reads

errors.name: NotRehomable
errors.msg: This month records no Fanex payee to re-home, or the config names no payer

types.name: ClaimsHeld
docs: One month's `claims_held_until` as `hold_claims` or `release_claims` left it, and who
signed (Rick, 2026-10-26).

types.name: ClaimsPaused
docs: `claims_paused_until` as `pause_claims` or `resume_claims` left it, and who signed.

types.name: ConfigKeys
docs: The keys `initialize_config` writes beside its accounts: every role but the admin, which is
an account so that its owner can be checked.

types.name: ConfigUpdate
docs: What `update_config` changes: each key it names, the others kept. The admin moves through
the `new_admin` account, the set-once fields through nothing.

types.name: ConfigUpdated
docs: Every key of the config after `initialize_config` or `update_config`.

types.name: DividendsConfig
docs: The program's one config (PDA: [CONFIG_SEED]), 403 bytes on chain (8 + 395).

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops `init_distributor`: the pauser or the admin sets it, the admin
alone clears it.

fields.name: claims_paused_until
docs: Unix seconds: a claim before it is refused (`ClaimsPaused`). Kept once it
has passed, as the time claims last opened again, which an expired month's
close reads (`CLAIMS_OPEN_BEFORE_CLOSE_SECONDS`); 0 on a fresh config.

fields.name: admin
docs: The upgrade Squad's vault, never the multisig account: every config
change, the funding unpause, `resume_claims` and `void_distributor`.

fields.name: pauser
docs: A hot key: pauses funding and claims, never resumes either.

fields.name: approver
docs: Co-signs every month's funding: a key of its own, neither funder
(`ApproverIsFunder`, Rick, 2026-10-21).

fields.name: closer
docs: Closes an expired month, beside its funder.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Set once: the classic SPL Token USDC, 6 decimals.

fields.name: pepper_funder
docs: Fanex's funder of a month, beside the dividend payer. Which key is open:
the receive-only fee wallet signs nothing (all-zero or the dividend payer
proposed), and never the production hot key.

fields.name: payer_funder
docs: The dividend payer, the funder of Fanex's months.

fields.name: curve_program
docs: Set once: `pepper_curve`, whose curves and v1 and v2 distributors
`init_distributor` reads by their seeds.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room to grow without a layout break.

types.name: FundingPauseSet
docs: The funding pause set or cleared, and who signed.

types.name: MonthRecord
docs: A month's record (PDA: [MONTH_SEED, mint, month as i64 LE]), 75 bytes on chain
(8 + 67). Created with the month and never closed: a month closed here never
opens again, a voided one may.

fields.name: status
docs: `MONTH_STATUS_OPEN`, `MONTH_STATUS_CLOSED` or `MONTH_STATUS_VOIDED`; 0 only
inside the funding that creates the record.

fields.name: distributor
docs: The distributor the month's last funding opened.

fields.name: funded_at
docs: Unix seconds of that funding.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room to grow without a layout break.

types.name: UsdcDistributor
docs: One token's month (PDA: [DISTRIBUTOR_SEED, mint, month as i64 LE]): the root
its claims prove against and the claims made. Its µUSDC sits in its vault, the
associated USDC account of this PDA. A header of `HEADER_SPACE` bytes, then
one bit per leaf.

fields.name: month
docs: The month's key (YYYYMM), as in `pepper_curve`: not validated, as there.

fields.name: merkle_root
docs: Root over this program's leaves (`math::dividend_leaf`).

fields.name: total_amount
docs: µUSDC the funding moved into the vault.

fields.name: claimed_amount
docs: µUSDC claimed so far, never above `total_amount`.

fields.name: funder_usdc_account
docs: The funder's USDC ATA, where the close and the void send the vault's
whole balance.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid the rents, and gets the vault's and the distributor's back.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix seconds: from then the funder or the closer may close the month.

fields.name: leaf_count
docs: Leaves the root commits to; `claimed` holds one bit for each.

fields.name: claims_held_until
docs: Unix seconds: this month's claims are refused before it (`ClaimsHeld`),
the hold the pauser or the admin sets on this month alone (Rick,
2026-10-26). The funding writes the end of its review window
(`REVIEW_WINDOW_SECONDS`, 2026-10-29); kept once it has passed, as when this
month's claims last opened again, which its close reads. Taken from the
reserved bytes on 2026-10-26.

fields.name: funded_by_fanex
docs: Whether the funder was one of Fanex's two funders at the funding
(`is_pepper_funder`): only then does `rehome_distributor` move the funder and
its USDC account, so a creator's leftovers never move. False in every month
funded before 2026-10-29. Taken from the reserved bytes on 2026-10-29.

fields.name: rents_by_payer
docs: Whether the config's dividend payer paid the rents (every funding since
2026-10-29, which refuses any other rent payer): only then does
`rehome_distributor` move the rent payer. Taken from the reserved bytes then.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room to grow without a layout break, before the bitmap, whose length varies.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Bit `index % 8` of byte `index / 8`, least significant first, set once
leaf `index` has claimed: exactly ⌈leaf_count / 8⌉ bytes.

types.name: UsdcDistributorClosed
docs: A month closed: `returned` µUSDC, the vault's whole balance, went to `to`, the
funder's recorded USDC account.

types.name: UsdcDistributorFunded
docs: A month funded: `total_amount` µUSDC moved from the funder into the vault.

types.name: UsdcDistributorRehomed
docs: A month's payees re-homed by the admin to the config's dividend payer (the internal audit,
2026-10-29): the three accounts it records after the write, the close's and the void's.

types.name: UsdcDistributorToppedUp
docs: A month topped up by its funder with the approver's signature (the internal audit,
2026-10-29): `amount` µUSDC more in the vault, `total_amount` as it now stands.

types.name: UsdcDistributorVoided
docs: A month voided by the admin before any claim: the same money move as a close,
and the month may be funded again.

types.name: UsdcDividendClaimed
docs: Leaf `index` paid `amount` µUSDC into the claimant's own USDC account.
